evidence: We leverage those insights to invest in emerging technologies and operations, including digital capabilities supported by artificial intelligence (AI), to introduce innovative products and services
Our competitive position may be impacted if we are unable to develop, use or integrate, in an effective, compliant and competitive manner, technology such as AI and machine learning
AI technologies may fail, underperform expectations or disrupt business operations, and there can be no assurance that our use of AI will enhance our products or services
We are also monitoring increased regulatory activity related to AI, including machine learning tools
ai_positioning.summary: AIZ intègre l'IA dans ses opérations et ses offres de produits pour améliorer l'expérience client et l'innovation, tout en restant vigilant face aux risques réglementaires et concurrentiels liés à cette technologie.
